title: Default temp-targets won't set from watch
symptom: When trying to set a predefined temp-target (ex. Eating Soon) from the new temp target tile on the watch, an error occurs. Setting manual temp-target from watch works OK.
cause: The issue is likely caused by version mismatch between the watch (dev) and phone (master).
fix: Use the same dev version on both watch and phone. The user reported that after updating both to dev versions, setting a temp target from the watch tiles worked.
evidence_quote: Probably fixed in one of the devs. Dev-F on watch and Dev-I on phone. Set _Activity_ from the watch tiles and phone set a TT of 150. It is now working.
